claims.exact_statement: For N=2^d frozen ordered modes X in {1,...,N}, a query t in {1,...,N-1} returns 1{X<=t} passed through an independent BSC(eta), 0<eta<1/2. At worst-case identification error delta in (0,1/4), midpoint adaptive search with r odd and r>=ln(d/delta)/C_eta reads per stage has Q_ad=d*r and error at most delta, where C_eta=-ln(2*sqrt(eta*(1-eta))). Any ex-ante randomized nonadaptive threshold schedule, even with repeated reads, complete outcome retention, and unrestricted decoding, has E[Q_na]>=(N-1)*max{1-2*delta, kl(1-delta||delta)/D_eta}, where D_eta=kl(1-eta||eta). A nonadaptive design that reads every threshold r_na=max{1,ceil(ln((2+delta)/delta)/C_eta)} times and returns the global MLE has error at most delta, so the optimal nonadaptive read count is Theta((N-1)*max{1,ln(1/delta)/D_eta}) up to absolute constants.
assumptions: The hidden mode is fixed throughout measurements.
The ordered labels and all threshold experiments are supplied and known to both policies.
The comparator has fixed known BSC noise eta with conditionally independent reads.
Nonadaptive schedules may be randomized before observations but cannot depend on outcomes; all outputs may be retained.
Each measurement read is charged, and each output is one bit.
claims.status: internally_reconstructed_proof; prior-art phenomenon; no novelty or nature claim
claims.novelty_boundary: The exponential adaptivity gap is the classical preset-versus-adaptive distinguishing-sequence and ordered-search phenomenon. The direct adjacent-pair KL accounting is a scoped noisy threshold specialization, not a priority claim. No unknown dynamics, observable acquisition, or biological system is covered.

costs.measurement: One charged sensor read per BSC observation; adaptive O(d*ln(d/delta)/C_eta) under the explicit midpoint policy; nonadaptive optimum Theta(N) for fixed eta and delta, with the full precision and confidence dependence recorded in the statement.
costs.precision: Fixed calibrated error eta; repetitions are fully charged. Analog precision-to-energy conversion requires an empirical cost function.
costs.address: Each threshold address has d=log2(N) bits; d address bits per read are charged when transmitted explicitly.
costs.memory: Adaptive midpoint controller uses O(d+log(r)) bits; nonadaptive baseline is allowed unrestricted retention, with Q one-bit outcomes.
costs.runtime: Adaptive midpoint requires d sequential feedback stages, or d rounds with r parallel reads per stage. Nonadaptive may use one batch round if N-scale hardware is available; total reads/work remain charged.
costs.setup: A common programmable comparator is supplied and calibrated once. Separately fabricating/calibrating each threshold may cost Theta(N) and can erase total-work advantage.

claims.falsifier: For an adjacent pair i and i+1, a fixed schedule omitting threshold i has identical transcript distributions under the stated interface. A demonstrated difference would refute the interface/proof premise.
claims.next_gate: Establish whether a real finite-state dynamical system offers a programmable nested threshold sensor whose calibration, state preservation, precision, and energy costs are measured and shared fairly across adaptive and nonadaptive designs.

claims.exact_statement: For an ex-ante nonadaptive schedule whose query j uses threshold t_j and BSC error eta_j in (0,1/2), worst-case identification error delta forces, at every adjacent boundary i, sum_{j:t_j=i} D_eta_j >= kl(1-delta||delta), and hence total query divergence sum_j D_eta_j >= (N-1)*kl(1-delta||delta).
assumptions: Same fixed ordered mode and threshold membership interface as AO-THRESHOLD-ADAPTIVITY-GAP.
Each scheduled query's precision is selected before observing measurement outcomes.
Precision-conditioned errors are known and independent across reads.
claims.status: internally reconstructed corollary from pairwise data processing
claims.novelty_boundary: This is an information-budget restatement of the same adjacent-pair lower bound, not a new general measurement theorem.

costs.information: One query at precision eta contributes D_eta only to the adjacent boundary matching its threshold.
costs.physical: A joule, dollar, or time lower bound follows only from a supplied or measured cost map c(eta), for example D_eta<=rho*c(eta).

claims.falsifier: Under the stated threshold/BSC interface, an adjacent pair must have identical outcomes at every threshold other than their boundary; evidence of information leakage elsewhere invalidates the model assumptions.
claims.next_gate: Measure the sensor's precision-cost curve and test whether repeated-read independence and threshold locality hold.
